review_text: NexTechX Solutions re-architected our legacy billing infrastructure into a high-concurrency microservices stack. Their engineering discipline, zero-downtime cutover, and transparent communication exceeded our high expectations.

The autonomous n8n workflows and OCR pipeline delivered by NexTechX cut our freight invoice processing time by 85%. What previously took hours of tedious manual data entry is now reconciled in minutes.

Their computer vision data annotation team handled over 250,000 medical image segmentation masks under strict HIPAA confidentiality with remarkable sub-pixel accuracy. Truly an enterprise-grade partner.

From day one, the NexTechX team understood our multi-tenant SaaS requirements. They built our subscription metering engine and customer portal ahead of schedule, enabling our team to hit our launch milestone smoothly.
